I haven't set up the Monday digest yet. My scheduler is rejecting jobs because the gateway is missing its credentials, so nothing is scheduled and nothing will post next Monday. I've replied in your thread with the details. Once an admin fixes the gateway auth, I can set it up and retry.

When it runs, it will read #coastal-team and #coastal-random. Those two channels have the same members, so nothing from one reaches anyone who couldn't already see it. Money terms (rates, prices, discounts, contract values, invoice amounts, payment terms) will stay out of the digest. Those go only to Anselm, June and the account owner, so the digest will point people to them instead.
